timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Are you looking for the best 4% for camping in your budget, while in today's video, we break down the top 5 best 4% for camping that are available on the market?
I made this list based on my personal opinion and I tried to list them based on their price quality, durability, and more to see the more information about these product.
I found these products much helpful for people like you.
You can check out the description below also make sure you subscribe for more videos.
Okay so let's get started with the video.
Number 5.
Coleman Sondom Tent
The Coleman Sondom 4% tent has a spacious interior allowing you to move around freely inside without feeling claustrophobic or annoyed with your tent partners.
It includes large windows and ground vents to ensure proper ventilation.
Furthermore, this tent includes the Coleman WeatherTech system with floors that are patented and inverted scenes to ensure you stay dry in even the worst conditions.
It comes available in two different color configurations so you can purchase according to your personal preferences.
This tent doesn't have any major design flaws.
I will attach a video above so you can get an idea of what this tent looks like in person.
I really don't think you can go wrong with this tent.
Number 4.
Coleman Tent With Screen Room
This Coleman 4% tent includes dark room technology which blocks out 97.5% of sunlight which allows you to sleep after sunrise if you are not the type to get up and tackle the day at 0600.
It also includes a separate screen room allows for bug free recreation and relaxation.
It includes the Coleman WeatherTech system with welded floors and inverted scenes to keep you and your fellow tent occupants dry even in unexpected inclement weather.
With a 4 feet 11 inches center height you may have to hunch your neck a bit to move around but not too much unless you're a giant like me.
Known issues some campers who have purchased and used this tent was that it was not as waterproof as claimed.
The Screen Room does a good job keeping out bugs and dirt however only the middle portion has a rain cover and the sides in front do get wet when it rains.
Number 3.
Coleman Popup Tent This Coleman offering features a multi protection rainfly for the perfect balance of protection and ventilation even in rainy conditions.
It is meant to easily and quickly deploy as well as tear down for simple and easy setup and it will easily pack up for quick and easy storage.

This tent is pretty basic and it is designed for functionality instead of bells and whistles but it does include two gear pockets for keeping your essentials at hand as well as taped floor seems to keep you dry and free from debris entering from the ground.
Number 2.
Core equipment for person instant dome tent the core for person instant dome tent features a zipper privacy for doors and windows.
This also includes a place to store your camping gear and personal supplies in an organized loft area a pretty cool and unique feature.
Additional accessories include a lantern hook for ambience lighting as well as several organizer pockets.
This tent also has an electrical cord access port a rainfly and a carrying bag.

Furthermore, patented core H20 block technology includes a combination of water repellent fabric that has an active bead runoff like rain ex on a windshield along with sealed seams and rain resistant door slash window seals.
Number 1.
Coleman Instant Cabin There are several features of this cabin style tent which permits the buyer with many comforts while out in the great outdoors.
This tent includes the Coleman WeatherTech system that has patented welded floors and inverted seams to ensure dryness to the occupants.
Also, it features rugged polyguard material with double the thickness so you will never have to worry about durability.
The rainfly includes an integrated vent for an advanced airflow that does not require any extra assembly.
This tent is very roomy and will comfortably sleep for adults.
